## History

Jerry Corcoran engaged in local politics by offering a political bribe to [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) near the [Lake of Shining Waters](../codex/places.md#lake-of-shining-waters). Unbeknownst to Jerry at the time, their transaction was accidentally overheard by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md).

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P50](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0050), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P61](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0061), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P65](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0065), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P66](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0066)_
